game.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
game.blurb: Medieval real-time strategy game, a remaster of 1999's Age of Empires II, from Forgotten Empires, Wicked Witch and Tantalus, released 2019-11-14. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Campaigns
chapters.summary: Finishing each campaign, from William Wallace and Joan of Arc through the many campaigns added since.

chapters.title: Campaign Mission Feats
chapters.summary: Optional goals inside named campaign missions, such as speed wins, relics, conversions and protecting allies.

chapters.title: Historical Battles, Victors and Vanquished, and Art of War
chapters.summary: Single historical battles with a year in their name, the Victors and Vanquished scenarios, and Art of War medals.

chapters.title: Civilization Victories
chapters.summary: A win with each civilization, and a win with every one of them.

chapters.title: Skirmish, AI and General Play
chapters.summary: Beating the AI at each difficulty, Regicide, team wins, and unit, economy and siege feats in any game.

chapters.title: Return of Rome
chapters.summary: Wins with each Return of Rome civilization and the feats that name that mode.

chapters.title: Chronicles: Battle for Greece and Alexander the Great
chapters.summary: The two Chronicles campaigns, their mission feats and their civilizations.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Strategy game, so chapters follow the modes the achievements show rather than a story. This is the 2019 remaster, with its own Steam app 813780; the Steam schema calls it "Phoenix" (an internal codename). The app list also has "Age of Empires II (Retired)" (221380), which was not used. None of the 370 Steam achievements is hidden. StrategyWiki has "Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition" at completion stage 0, marked as a stub; only its "Table of Contents" subpage is written, and its Walkthrough, Civilizations, Gameplay and New features subpages are not, so nothing was used. The page also links the separate guide for the 1999 original, "Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings" (completion stage 3, with written mission pages such as "The Maid of Orleans" and "Pax Mongolia"); it was not used, because the Definitive Edition has many more campaigns than that guide covers, though it could seed CC BY-SA mission notes for the original five campaigns later. The Chronicles chapter places 39 achievements by exact name: those whose descriptions name "Chronicles" or "the Battle for Greece campaign", plus the mission feats and the Thracian and Puru victories that sit with them in the Steam list (positions 276 to 301 and 332 to 344); the position-based ones are guesses. Campaigns that the data does not tie to a named add-on (for example Sargon, Pyrrhus, Trajan and the Ascent of Egypt) sit in the main campaign chapter. ageofempires.fandom.com answers the API under "Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition" with about 236 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Most campaign feats unlock for under 2% of Steam players.
